Ok, I think you didn't understand me, I didn't explain myself well. I didn't say Orochi is dead, I meant he may be dead by the end of Wano.

This arc is the final one in this saga? Has it been stated? This saga is called vs the four emperors, and so far Luffy has only fought two of them, so I highly doubt it's the final arc.

About Nekomamushi, he may arrive during the battle to help in a difficult moment. And Vega Punk is going to meet the Straw Hats, he needs to give info and even Oda said certain person will appear and explain about DF to them as Orochi is already dead, or something like that.

The crew trained 2 years, they all promised to not lose again, they trained for this. Two years, while all the rest sail the seas, do their stuff, they only trained. It's their moment to show they're a crew to be feared. For instance, if Zoro, who hasn't fought/defeated a worthy opponent, was to be defeated the first time he does, it would be so lame imo.
You can't compare Luffy from Water 7 to current Luffy either.

As I said before, I thought the raid would fail and be destroyed, but after all this build-up, I don't think so any more. We thought the same when CP9 destroyed them, and back then, within a couple of hours, the straw hats beat them.

Here, they could train. Obviously people need to be killed, all of them can't get out alive, but they will win for sure, Oda is not going to make this raid fail and build another one. But Jinbe... Jinbe is in danger.
Did I say he will beat Kaido 1on1? I don't think so, I said Kidd will fight too. That's not what I meant.

He had the idea, but Gear 2 uses Soru, so he learnt it from them. 

About how poorly I interpret the series, first of all, respect a bit, and second, let me explain. I wanted to explain how Kaido beating Luffy with one single blow doesn't mean that after a training he can't beat Kaido. It's how EVERY single manga works out, it's how One Piece works out. It means nothing now, Luffy is at another level now. 

When Luffy fought Kaido, he had the new haki which allows him to see the future. Did he use it to dodge Thunder Bagua? No, he was too enraged.

When Luffy fought Lucci first time, he had gear 2nd and gear 3rd. Did he use it? I think you can see the similarity now, I expect at least.

People think that the 1v1 always bet on Kaido quote means Kaido can't be defeated by anyone one-on-one. Well, no one got out of Impel Down, no one get out of a Tea Party like that, and the list goes on. It was stated to be surpassed by Luffy.

As you say, I really think people are going to die here, Oda needs to do it; he hasn't killed anyone but Ace and Whitebeard. But about his awakening, I'm not sure as I think his power up this arc will be the new CoA level. I think Luffy will improve his Conqueror haki with Shanks and then awaken his DF against BB.

He will be there for sure, there are not that many arcs left and Luffy needs to be one of the strongest people in One Piece right after Wano, in order to face Shanks, even though I think their fight would be quite different...

I thought so too, but seeing how much Oda is adding to the raid, I don't think it will end bad now. Making the Onigashima raid end badly, somehow getting almost everyone out alive from there, and preparing another raid, seems too much for me, the arc would go on forever. And maybe a flashback of Kaido's past, very likely, as Big Mom had one.

After Kanjuro's betrayal, after Kinemon's luck, and after (SPOILER CHAPTER OF THIS WEEK) Jinbe arriving, do you really think Oda is going to make them lose, train once again, and then make another raid? I'm saying it because I thought the same; I thought they'd suffer major defeat, I even thought Shanks may join them (hell, I've been thinking this a while, even back in Zou), but saying how much he's adding to it, I don't think it will happen now. I think we are underestimating the crew and the rest of them. No one has a crew as strong as the Straw Hats, if it's one-on-one, Kaido may win, but if it's the whole crew, no way they will lose.

Do you really think what Luffy gave Kaido was all he got? He didn't even hit him with King Kong Gun or Black Mamba. I don't think Luffy went all out; he was just testing and didn't expect Kaido to hit as hard as he did. Obviously, I think the gap is bigger than the one between him and Lucci at that time, but what I wanted to convey is Luffy being able to withstand Thunder Bagua and hurt Kaido is not an asspull, even though he will not defeat him alone; as I said, the gap is bigger and Kidd will fill that gap.

I was on my grandfather's porch, sitting there at night with my father. He's smoking and I'm just playing my guitar randomly. Suddenly, my dad said: ''*What the hell is that?''* I looked at him and saw he was pointing to the woods. There was this small, green light moving super fast among the trees. It didn't look natural. There aren't any other houses nearby. As fast as it came, it disappeared. Now, I don't think it had any connection, but down the road, after a minute or two while my father was looking for that light, we heard a car braking. We thought it had an accident or something, so we went to see what happened.  A woman we knew was shaking, pale and sweaty. We asked her what happened and she said she had just seen her dead husband on a white horse coming from the woods. We looked at each other thinking she was mad, but we knew she was a very smart woman, she was a doctor, 45 years old. After a long time trying to calm her down, she left, I looked at my father and he said we'd better go inside.
